card.name: "Of" after risk before an outcome
card.fires_on: The word "of" right after "risk" (or after a risk figure) when the next words name a harmful outcome, such as drug-related mortality or suicidal thinking. Also fires once on "-related" in "drug-related mortality".

modes.label: "of" after risk
modes.description: The linking word "of" after "increases the risk" that leads into a named adverse outcome.
modes.example: concomitant use of opioid analgesics and benzodiazepines increases the risk<< of>> drug-related mortality compared to use of opioids

modes.label: "of" after risk statistics
modes.description: "of" after a relative risk and confidence interval, before the outcome.
modes.example: the risk (adjusted Relative Risk 1.8, 95% confidence interval [CI]: 1.2, 2.7)<< of>> suicidal thinking or behavior compared to patients randomized

modes.label: Inside "drug-related"
modes.description: The hyphenated "-related" in the outcome phrase "drug-related mortality".
modes.example: increases the risk of drug<<-related>> mortality compared to use of opioid analges

card.writes: It seems to promote words about likelihood and probability, and to suppress unrelated continuations.
card.plain: It marks the little word "of" in "risk of" just before a bad outcome is named in a warning.
